notes.title: Development postponed for foreseeable future
notes.content:
Calling all Aviators,

Hope you’re all doing well and that you’re enjoying the game so far.

Unfortunately I’m going to have to postpone the continued development of Aviators for the foreseeable future due to illness. I’m really sorry to have to take this decision, but I have to prioritize my health at this point. 

But, I will be back with continued development, all the old ideas are here ready to go as well as new ones. So I really hope you’ll respect my decision at this point and that you’ll still be here when I get back on track health wise.

All the best,

Emil aka Eclipse Studios

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Aviators, 10% off!
notes.content:
Aviators is Now Available on Steam Early Access and is 10% off!*

Aviators is a chaotic and highly competitive online party game played in teams with up to 4 players a side. Work together to secure victory for your team by any means necessary, even if it means sacrificing yourself like a true kamikaze Aviator.

*Offer ends January 26 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Aviators FAQ - updated
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26621458/e86d1673cb41db1e07bbf5a3bd86e99db7517773.png[/img]

Calling all Aviators!

We’re merely days away from launching the game into Early Access and we’re so excited to finally share the game with you. 

Here's a small updated FAQ regarding Early Access and what it means to us.

Q: [b]What does Early Access mean?[/b]
A: [i]In short, that the game is still very much under development. You can play online, forming teams with people all over the world with up to 4 people a side, (each game has two teams) but as of now there’s only one world that’s playable.[/i]

Q: [b]Where will you go from here?[/b] 
A: [i]The plan is to introduce multiple worlds, game modes, and even more customization. For this  we need your help as having a large number of people playing, as well as providing feedback on what you would like to see, is key to making this the best game it can possibly be.[/i]

Q: [b]What will Early Access cost?[/b]
A: [i]We’re starting off at $2.99, (local prices may vary), and will build from there as the game fleshes out (see above).[/i]

Q: [b]I'm having problems installing/starting the game. Who should I talk to?[/b]
A: [i]Either send an email to us at developers@aviatorsgame.com or write a comment here on Steam. We try to keep an eye on everything posted.[/i] 

Q: [b]Will the Early Access of Aviators be supported on Mac /Linux?[/b]
A: [i]The game will  initially support Mac and depending on the feedback we receive later we will look at porting the game to Linux as well.[/i]

Q: [b]How do I report bugs and give suggestions and/or feedback?[/b]
A: [i]Either use the Steam discussion forum to post your problems or send us an email to developers@aviatorsgame.com.[/i]

Q: [b]Finally, is the game fun?[/b]
A: [i]It’s friendship-ruining kamikaze-awesome fun.[/i]

/Eclipse Studios

notes.title: T - 1 week
notes.content:
Calling all aviators!

We’re happy to announce that Aviators will go into Early Access on January 19th, that means in just one week!

In going live we welcome you all on board for the continued journey to a finished game and beyond. 

The first release will feature online battles with up to four people to each side and the customization of your own character.

Looking forward to meeting you all in the skies!

/Dev team

notes.title: Aviators FAQ
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26621458/e86d1673cb41db1e07bbf5a3bd86e99db7517773.png[/img]

Hello Cadets!

We are about to finish the first part of our work on Aviators and ship the Early Access version so you all can try it. It's been a thrilling time, where we have fine tuned the code and the concept as well as added more gaming fun into this gem. We feel that the way we are heading now is even more powerful and will bring the ultimate competitive experience to you guys! 

Here's a small FAQ regarding Beta / Early Access.

Q: [b]Will there be a Beta, and if so, when?[/b]
A: [i]Yes, the first closed session will be held between now and roughly a few weeks into November. More beta tests are planned after that but will be announced at a later date. Remember, this is a closed Beta, only people who are invited will be able to participate. You’re more than welcome to put your name in the running though by sending an email to support@501Industries.com.[/i]

Q: [b]How does the Early Access version differ from the Beta?[/b]
A: [i]In the middle of November Early Access begins and the game opens up to be played by  anyone who wants to buy the game. Other than that, the Early Access version will basically be the same as the Beta testing, just more polished from having been through it.[/i]

Q: [b]Will my Alpha/Beta key let me play in Early Access?[/b]
A: [i]No, access through the Beta testing will not carry over to Early Access.[/i]

Q: [b]What will Early Access cost?[/b]
A: [i]The target price will be €7.99 on Steam (local prices may vary).[/i]

Q: [b]How are the Beta testers chosen?[/b]
A: [i]The participants are chosen in order to get a good mix of players with varying levels of experience of games similar to Aviators. We’re also looking to test across platforms.[/i]

Q: [b]I'm having problems installing/starting the game. Who should I talk to?[/b]
A: [i]Either send an email to us at support@501industries.com or go to our [url=https://discord.gg/kYh6pJ4]Discord channel[/url]  where we hang out daily during business hours CET.[/i]

Q: [b]Will the Early Access of Aviators be supported on Mac /Linux?[/b]
A: [i]Our goal is to initially support Mac and depending on the feedback we receive later look at porting the game to Linux as well.[/i]

Q: [b]How do I report bugs and give suggestions and/or feedback?[/b]
A: [i]Either use the Steam discussion forum to post your problems or visit our Discord channel to chat with us, or send us an email to support@501industies.com.[/i]

Q: [b]Finally, is the game fun?[/b]
A: [i]It’s kamikaze-awesome fun.[/i]

/Dev team
